comments.note: No blocking issues found. Implementation is clean and idiomatic. The symmetric += (constructor) / -= (Dispose) pattern is the correct approach. sealed class means GC.SuppressFinalize(this) is not required — no subclass finalizers possible. Initializing _isRunning via the backing field in the constructor (not the generated property) correctly avoids triggering NotifyCanExecuteChangedFor during construction before the view is bound — standard CommunityToolkit.Mvvm pattern.
